answer: Mail every new earning key a paper postcard with a one-time opal-colored code, sent to a street address it registers; the code must be typed back within 14 epochs, and one address unlocks at most 3 keys per year. A farm can forge a thousand keypairs in a second, but not a thousand mailboxes: 1,000 fakes need 334 addresses, about $10/month each as rented boxes, or $3,340 monthly, and a code entered by two keys voids both. An honest agent pays one stamp; the sybil pays for the timber of every post.
